cohort: The study recruited 19 pregnant women aged 27-40 years, divided into two groups based on triglyceride levels (Group A: <= 150 mg/dL; Group B: > 150 mg/dL).
finding: Elevated maternal triglyceride levels, LDL cholesterol, and BMI are associated with altered fetal cardiac function parameters, specifically reduced global longitudinal strain, at mid-gestation.
